text:
Jordan: rolling deploy v3.2.1 -> started canary 1  (174s ago)
Jordan: seeing 5xx spikes from canary: ~8% over last 2 mins (baseline 0.5%). Notable: traces dashboard shows nothing per-canary, only global aggregates. Can't correlate requests to instance yet. :rotating_light:
Maria: on it. can we kill the FF for canary rollout? if so i'll flip.
Kevin: paging noise — the 5xx alert is firing but it's using global metric, not per-canary. We should mute that alert for this rollout or set to per-canary.
Maria: doing kill now
Maria: ```
# kill feature flag for rollout
/ff toggle canary_v3_2_1 off --reason "canary 5xx spikes"
# response: feature flag canary_v3_2_1 -> OFF
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag change submitted by maria — canary_v3_2_1 is OFF
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-INC1234 created and assigned to Kevin
Kevin: I have PD-INC1234. pulling logs from canary host-17 now. logs show upstream _503_ from router timeouts. agent-side traces missing, likely tracing header stripped by envoy in this rollout step.
Jordan: ugh, that explains missing per-canary traces — the new envoy filter removed x-trace-id header in step 3 of the deploy. who authored that filter? @maria ?
Maria: that was me, i added a conservative header sanitizer patch — i thought x-trace-id was safe but looks like i overzealous. reverting patch.
Maria: ```
# revert envfilter change
git revert 6a2f3b and redeploy tracer-config
```
Alyssa: i'm taking handoff at 22:00 PT. status?
Jordan: canary OFF, global 5xx alert muted for the moment, PD assigned to Kevin for post-rollback verification. customer-visible error rate peaked at ~2% for a subset of tenants (payments/checkout flow). No major revenue loss detected yet, support saw ~12 tickets.
Kevin: verification done — error rate falling back to baseline after FF kill and tracer revert. I will keep an eye for 30m then close PD.
Alyssa: noted. i'll keep console alerts unmuted but add a suppression rule for the noise until postmortem.
Jordan: created incident ticket INC-2026-0456 w/ summary + timeline + links to logs and FF command
Jordan: postmortem owners: maria (deploy change), kevin (oncall verification), alyssa (SLO/alerting)
pagerduty-bot: PD-INC1234 status -> acknowledged by Kevin
Kevin: closing PD in 20m if stable. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: handoff: Jordan -> Alyssa :wave: please review playbook and contact customers in escalation list if we see more regressions.
Alyssa: ack, taking over. will follow up with postmortem draft tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Deploy v3.2.1 halted and rollback completed for canary cohort. logs and traces re-enabled.
Jordan: thanks everyone — we'll run a blameless postmortem and update alerting rules to be per-canary by default before any rollout with header changes.
Maria: sorry for the churn — notes saved in INC-2026-0456. :pray:
pagerduty-bot: PD-INC1234 closed by Kevin
Jordan: thread lock — handing to Alyssa for follow-up. :lock:
